officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: Stage 19 Kynnefjälls natur - Vaktarekullen
keyFacts: Current WST API name is 19. Kynnefjälls natur-Vaktarekullen.
Page title renders Kynnefjälls natur - Vaktarekullen.
Canonical direction is Kynnefjälls natur to Vaktarekullen.
Official rounded distance is 16 km.
Official estimated time is 5-6 h.
Official difficulty is Blue / medium.
Surface is forest path and gravel road.
WST describes this as the first stage entering Bohuslän's largest continuous wilderness area.
WST warns that there are few roads/buildings, sparse public transport, no near-trail resupply and that hikers should carry charged batteries.
WST says the start can be reached via Bråmarkenvägen and that Vaktarekullen itself is not public-transport accessible.
caveats: WST English body text still says the stage starts in Lunden, while title/API/geometry and Munkedal support Kynnefjälls natur as current start.
Preserve Lunden - Vaktarekullen as a stale/legacy alias, not as canonical current from/to.

officialSources.title: Länsstyrelsen Västra Götaland: Kynnefjäll
keyFacts: Kynnefjäll reserve consists of Kynnefjäll A, Kynnefjäll B Skogsallmänningen and Kynnefjäll-Sätret.
Bohusleden crosses the reserve.
Reserve area is 1882 ha, managed by Västkuststiftelsen, in Munkedal and Tanum.
Most of the area is Natura 2000.

Restrictions include fire only at manager-designated places, no motor vehicles, boats/canoes only on designated waters, tents only at manager-designated places, no digging plants and no collecting mosses/lichens.
Kynnefjäll A has fishing restrictions in Stora Holmevatten.
Sensitive birdlife at Stora Holmevatten is explicitly flagged.
caveats: Rules vary by subarea; final normalization needs GIS overlay for Kynnefjäll A/B/Sätret.

lanes.summary: Verified WST/Naturkartan/Munkedal identity, WST GPX metadata, legacy Lunden alias/prose contradiction, wilderness/remoteness warning, Vaktarekullen/Kasebo facility clues and 2026 burn/windthrow advisories.

Confirmed WST/API/GPX, Naturkartan GPX and Naturkartan API matching navigation-grade-after-dedupe geometry, 2109 raw points / 703 unique points / 16.376 km, exact official joins to Stages 18 and 20, and OSM relation 4492852 corroboration with a 60 m start offset.

Collected KynnefjällsNatur, Äntervattnet, Påsholk, Säveleken, Vaktarekullen cabin/toilet/fire/view/spring, Kasebo access/rest metadata, pending Sågen/picnic/OSM shelter and off-route Lunden/Bredmossen/Stora Holmevatten suppress decisions.

Captured Bråmarkenvägen line 834 and KynnefjällsNatur road start access, Vaktarekullen non-road/non-transit endpoint, Kasebo parking connector, sparse line 835 east-side connectors, distant line 883 options and Närtrafik caveats.

Captured current route identity, stale Lunden-Vaktarekullen route-app/blog sources, 2026 burn warning, wet/boggy and winter wayfinding reports, Vaktarekullen water conflict and shelter/cabin field context.

Captured Kynnefjäll reserve/Natura, designated-only fire/tenting, Stora Holmevatten bird sensitivity, Vaktarekullen boil-water spring, planned 2026 burns, remote plateau hazards and live fire-ban needs.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Stage 19 is strong enough for later normalization with caveats. No targeted follow-up batch needed before moving to Stage 20; remaining issues are GIS overlay, Lunden alias handling, Kasebo connector modeling, Säveleken coordinate reconciliation, Vaktarekullen spring currentness and live burn/fire/transit checks.

Keep Lunden - Vaktarekullen as legacy alias and decide whether Lunden/Vaktarestugan detour data belongs in a connector layer.
Reconcile Säveleken shelter WST versus OSM coordinate mismatch of about 120 m before final facility import.
Decide whether Kasebo, Kasebo rest shelter, Lilla Holmevatten and Stora Holmevatten are imported only as connector/detour/Stage 20-adjacent metadata.
Verify Vaktarekullen spring availability and condition shortly before publication; keep boil/treat and carry-backup warning.
Live-check planned Kynnefjäll 2026 burns, windthrow cleanup, fire bans and WST/Västkuststiftelsen status before publication.
Exact-date checks needed for Västtrafik line 834, line 835 and Närtrafik before any public access guidance.

importReadiness.readyGeometry: true after consecutive duplicate removal; official WST/Naturkartan geometry is continuous, current and corroborated, but elevation is unusable and start has OSM/facility offset caveat
importReadiness.readyFacilities: partial; main shelters/cabin/start service are researched, but Säveleken coordinate reconciliation, OSM-only/pending shelters/rest areas, and Kasebo/Lunden/Stora Holmevatten connector scoping remain
importReadiness.readyCommuteAccess: partial; Bråmarkenvägen and KynnefjällsNatur start access are researched, but Vaktarekullen is remote and north-side access depends on Kasebo connector/long sparse bus options
importReadiness.readyRules: partial; Kynnefjäll reserve/Natura and planned-burn rules are strong, but exact subsegments need GIS overlay and live burn/fire checks
doNotImportYet: Do not integrate into data/source/hiking, public/data, public/routes or generated runtime outputs in this research-only phase.
Do not use Lunden as current Stage 19 start.
Do not use old 10.8 km / 14-15 km Lunden-Vaktarekullen route-app tracks as current geometry.
Do not import GPX elevation values.
Do not mark general wild camping allowed inside Kynnefjäll reserve.
Do not mark fire allowed except at verified designated places and after live fire-ban checks.
Do not mark Vaktarekullen spring or any lake/stream water as potable as-is.
Do not import Bredmossen, Lunden/Vaktarestugan, Kasebo, Lilla Holmevatten or Stora Holmevatten as on-route Stage 19 facilities without connector/detour modeling.
Do not present Vaktarekullen as public-transport or road accessible.
Do not expose KynnefjällsNatur parking/services as always-public without access verification.
